scope: Proposition 7.1 (An exact presentation) of the manuscript “Uniform log Iitaka fibrations and bounded moduli denominators” (preprints/Uniform-log-Iitaka-fibrations-and-bounded-moduli-denominators-October-4-2026/uniform-log-iitaka.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fee79cbeaa3ae4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an integer d ≥ 1 and a finite set Φ ⊂ [0, 1]∩Q. There is an integer p0 = p0(d, Φ) > 0, clearing the denominators of Φ, with the following property. Let f : X → Z be a contraction of normal projective varieties with dim X ≤ d, and let (X, B) be lc with B ≥ 0 and nonzero coefficients in Φ. Suppose that KX + B is Q-Cartier and KX + B ∼Q f∗ L for a Q-Cartier divisor L on Z. Then there are ψ ∈ C(X)∗ and a Q-Cartier divisor DZ ∼Q L such that KX + B + 1 p0 div(ψ) = f∗ DZ. (7.1)
